ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the trapezoid ABCD, AD $\parallel$ BC, $\angle BAD = 90^\circ$, and the diagonal BD $\perp$ DC. If AD = 4 and BC = 9, what is the length of BD?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given: $\because$ AD$\parallel$BC $\therefore$ $\angle$ADB=$\angle$CBD (When two lines are parallel, the corresponding alternate interior angles are equal)\\
$\because$ $\angle$BAD=$90^\circ$, BD$\perp$DC, $\therefore$ $\angle$BAD=$\angle$BDC=$90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle$ADB=$\angle$CBD, $\angle$BAD=$\angle$BDC, $\therefore$ $\triangle$ABD$\sim$$\triangle$DCB (Two triangles are similar if two angles are equal respectively)\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{BD}{BC}=\frac{AD}{BD}$ (Corresponding sides of similar triangles are proportional)\\
$\therefore$ $BD^2=AD\times BC$, $\because$AD=4, BC=9\\
$\therefore$BD=\boxed{6}
